english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for something involving the whole world.
This is the everyday all-purpose choice for something concerning or affecting the world as a whole.

examples.english: This film will be released in cinemas worldwide.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲會喺全世界嘅戲院上映。
